questions.text: एक निर्माणी कम्पनी 'विशेष कन्स्ट्रक्शन्स' ने 'हेलमेट नहीं, प्रवेश नहीं' को सख्ती से लागू करने का निर्णय लिया और निम्नलिखित चिह्न को अपने निर्माण स्थल पर लगा दिया। उपर्युक्त चिह्न द्वारा इंगित योजना के प्रकार की पहचान कीजिए:
questions.text_english: 'Vishesh Constructions', a construction company, decided to strictly implement 'No Helmet, No Entry' and put the following sign at their construction sites. Identify the type of plan indicated by the above sign:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Rule. A rule is the simplest type of plan that describes specific required actions or non-actions with no discretion. 'No Helmet, No Entry' is a definite, rigid directive that allows no deviation — workers must wear helmets or they will not be permitted entry. This makes it a Rule, not a Policy (which provides general guidance with some discretion), not a Method (which describes how to perform a task), and not a Programme (which is a complex set of activities with a time schedule).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) नियम है। नियम योजना का सबसे सरल प्रकार है जो बिना किसी विवेकाधिकार के विशेष अपेक्षित कार्यों या गैर-कार्यों को निर्धारित करता है। 'हेलमेट नहीं, प्रवेश नहीं' एक निश्चित, कठोर निर्देश है जिसमें कोई विचलन नहीं है। यह नीति नहीं है क्योंकि नीति में विवेकाधिकार होता है, विधि नहीं है क्योंकि विधि कार्य करने के तरीके को बताती है, और कार्यक्रम भी नहीं है।

questions.text: आकाश मेहरा 'केदान्ता एन्टरप्राइज़ेज़' का विपणन प्रबन्धक है। वह आदेश देता है और यह उम्मीद करता है कि उसके अधीनस्थ उनका पालन करें। अधीनस्थों के साथ उसका केवल एक-मार्गीय सम्प्रेषण है तथा वे केवल उसके द्वारा दिए गए आदेश अनुसार ही कार्य करते हैं। आकाश मेहरा की नेतृत्व शैली की पहचान कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Akash Mehra is the Marketing Manager of 'Kedanta Enterprises'. He gives orders and expects his subordinates to obey those orders. Communication is only one-way with the subordinates only acting according to the command given by him. Identify the leadership style of Akash Mehra:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Authoritative. Akash gives orders and expects unconditional obedience, with only one-way communication — all characteristic features of an Authoritative (also called Autocratic) leadership style. Participative leadership involves subordinates in decision-making; Free-rein gives complete freedom to subordinates; Pragmatic is not a standard leadership style classification in Business Studies.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) सत्तावादी है। आकाश आदेश देता है और बिना शर्त पालन की अपेक्षा करता है तथा संचार केवल एक-मार्गीय है — ये सभी सत्तावादी नेतृत्व शैली की विशेषताएँ हैं। सहभागी नेतृत्व में अधीनस्थों को निर्णय लेने में शामिल किया जाता है; स्वतंत्रात्मक में अधीनस्थों को पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता दी जाती है।

questions.text: प्रबन्ध के 'निर्देशन' कार्य के महत्त्व के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से गलत कथन का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english: From the following, choose the incorrect statement about the importance of 'Directing' function of management:

options.A: वांछित उद्देश्यों की प्राप्ति में संगठन के व्यक्तियों के कार्य को प्रारंभ करने में निर्देशन सहायता करता है।
options.B: निर्देशन संगठन में कर्मचारियों के व्यक्तिगत प्रयासों को इस प्रकार समन्वित करता है कि प्रत्येक व्यक्ति के कार्य का योगदान संगठन के निष्पादन में होता है।
options.C: निर्देशन संगठन में आवश्यक परिवर्तनों को प्रारंभ करने में मदद करता है।
options.D: निर्देशन संगठन में मानव-शक्ति आवश्यकताओं का अनुमान लगाने में सहायता करता है।

options_english.A: Directing helps to initiate action by people in the organization towards attainment of desired objectives.
options_english.B: Directing integrates employees' efforts in the organization in such a way that every individual effort contributes to the organization's performance.
options_english.C: Directing facilitates introduction of needed changes in the organization.
options_english.D: Directing helps in estimating manpower requirements for the organization.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) — this is the incorrect statement about Directing. Estimating manpower requirements is a function of Staffing, not Directing. Directing is concerned with guiding, instructing, and inspiring people to achieve organisational goals. Options A, B, and C are all genuine and correct points of importance of Directing, making option D the odd one out.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है — यह निर्देशन के बारे में गलत कथन है। मानव-शक्ति आवश्यकताओं का अनुमान लगाना कार्मिक प्रबन्धन (Staffing) का कार्य है, न कि निर्देशन का। विकल्प A, B और C निर्देशन के महत्त्व के सही बिन्दु हैं।

questions.text: संगठन में भावी कर्मचारियों को ढूँढने और उन्हें संगठन में पदों के लिए आवेदन करने के लिए प्रेरित करने की प्रक्रिया को _____________ कहते हैं।
questions.text_english: ____________ is the process of searching for prospective employees and stimulating them to apply for jobs in the organization.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Recruitment. Recruitment is defined as the process of searching for prospective employees and stimulating them to apply for jobs in the organisation. Training refers to imparting skills to existing employees; Selection is the process of choosing the best candidate from the pool of applicants; Development is a broader concept related to overall growth of employees.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) भर्ती है। भर्ती वह प्रक्रिया है जिसके द्वारा संगठन में भावी कर्मचारियों को ढूँढा जाता है और उन्हें पदों के लिए आवेदन करने के लिए प्रेरित किया जाता है।

questions.text: प्रतिभूतियों को इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप में रखने की प्रक्रिया को _______________ कहते हैं।
questions.text_english: ____________ is the process of holding securities in an electronic form.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Dematerialization. Dematerialization is the process of converting physical securities (share certificates) into an electronic form and holding them in a Demat account. Rolling Settlement refers to the process of settling trades on a rolling basis (T+2); Registration is the process of registering securities; Depository is the institution that holds the securities in electronic form, not the process itself.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) विभौतिकीकरण है। विभौतिकीकरण भौतिक प्रतिभूतियों (शेयर प्रमाण-पत्रों) को इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप में बदलने और डीमैट खाते में रखने की प्रक्रिया है।

questions.text: सुधा और श्वेता जुड़वाँ बहनें थीं। महाविद्यालय से अपनी शिक्षा पूर्ण करने के बाद उन्होंने व्यवसाय प्रारंभ करने का निर्णय लिया। चूँकि वे वाणिज्य की विद्यार्थी थीं अत: वे 'क्या करना है' तथा 'कैसे करना है' के निर्णयन के महत्त्व को जानती थीं। यह उनके लिए बहुत चुनौतीपूर्ण था क्योंकि इस निर्णय से उनकी सभी भावी क्रियाएँ मार्गदर्शित होनी थीं। इसकी चर्चा अपनी माताजी के साथ करते समय उन्हें 'क्लाउड किचन' आरम्भ करने का एक नया विचार आया। दोनों बहनें इसे आरंभ करने के लिए बहुत अधिक उत्साहित थीं। इस विचार ने एक ठोस योजना का रूप लिया और एक माह में ही वे अपनी 'क्लाउड किचन' आरम्भ करने में सफल हो गईं। उपर्युक्त स्थिति में नियोजन के महत्त्व के जिस बिन्दु पर प्रकाश डाला गया है, उसे पहचानिए:
questions.text_english: Sudha and Shweta were twin sisters. After completing their education from college, they decided to start a business. As they were Commerce students, they knew the importance of deciding in advance 'what to do' and 'how to do'. It was very challenging for them as this decision was to guide all their future actions. While discussing the same with their mother, they got a new idea of starting a 'Cloud Kitchen'. Both the sisters were very excited to start this. The idea took the shape of a concrete plan and within a month, they were successful in starting their 'Cloud Kitchen'. Identify the point of importance of planning highlighted in the above case:

options.A: नियोजन अनिश्चितता के जोखिम को कम करता है।
options.B: नियोजन नव-प्रवर्तन विचारों को प्रोत्साहित करता है।
options.C: नियोजन नियंत्रण के मानकों का निर्धारण करता है।
options.D: नियोजन अतिव्याप्ति तथा अपव्ययी क्रियाओं को कम करता है।

options_english.A: Planning reduces the risk of uncertainty.
options_english.D: Planning reduces overlapping and wasteful activities.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Planning promotes innovative ideas. The case highlights that while discussing their plan, Sudha and Shweta got a new innovative idea of starting a 'Cloud Kitchen'. This clearly shows that the planning process promotes innovative and creative thinking. The other options are valid benefits of planning but are not specifically illustrated in this scenario.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) नियोजन नव-प्रवर्तन विचारों को प्रोत्साहित करता है। इस स्थिति में सुधा और श्वेता को योजना बनाते समय 'क्लाउड किचन' का नया विचार आया, जो दर्शाता है कि नियोजन प्रक्रिया नव-प्रवर्तन को प्रोत्साहित करती है।

questions.text:
कॉलम I में दी गई विपणन प्रबन्ध दर्शन का कॉलम II में दिए गए उनके मुख्य केन्द्र-बिन्दु से मिलान कीजिए:
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Match the Marketing Management philosophies given in Column I with their main focus given in Column II:
Choose the correct option from the following:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) 1-(iv), 2-(ii), 3-(i), 4-(iii). The Production concept focuses on quantity/availability of product (iv); the Product concept focuses on quality, performance and features of the product (ii); the Marketing concept focuses on customers' needs (i); and the Societal Marketing concept focuses on customers' needs as well as societal well-being (iii). This is the standard matching as taught in CBSE Business Studies.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है: 1-(iv), 2-(ii), 3-(i), 4-(iii)। उत्पादन अवधारणा — उत्पाद की मात्रा; उत्पाद अवधारणा — गुणवत्ता, निष्पादन और विशेषताएँ; विपणन अवधारणा — उपभोक्ताओं की आवश्यकताएँ; विपणन की सामाजिक अवधारणा — उपभोक्ताओं की आवश्यकताएँ तथा सामाजिक कल्याण।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R)। नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
अभिकथन (A): विकेन्द्रीकरण एक ऐच्छिक नीति निर्णय है।
कारण (R): यह शीर्ष प्रबन्ध के विवेकानुसार किया जाता है।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from those given below:
Assertion (A): Decentralization is an optional policy decision.
Reason (R): It is done at the discretion of the top management.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Both the Assertion and the Reason are true, and the Reason correctly explains the Assertion. Decentralization is indeed an optional policy decision (Assertion is true) because it is left to the discretion of top management to decide how much authority to delegate downward in the hierarchy (Reason is true and correctly explains why it is optional — it depends on top management's judgment).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण, अभिकथन का सही स्पष्टीकरण है। विकेन्द्रीकरण एक ऐच्छिक नीति निर्णय है क्योंकि यह शीर्ष प्रबन्ध के विवेकानुसार किया जाता है।

questions.text: सुशांत 'कायरो लिमिटेड' का एक योग्य परियोजना प्रबंधक था। सुशांत के प्रमुख नवीन ने सुशांत को एक नई परियोजना सौंपी। सुशांत के पास पहले से ही बहुत काम था। अत: सुशांत ने अपने तीन अधीनस्थों के बीच इस कार्य को बाँटने का निर्णय लिया। उसने अपने पास कार्य के उस भाग को रखा है जिसे वह स्वयं प्रभावपूर्ण ढंग से कर सकता है और जो बच गया, उसमें उसने अपने अधीनस्थों से सहायता ली है। इस कारण परियोजना समय पर पूर्ण हो गई। परियोजना को पूर्ण करने के लिए सुशांत द्वारा उपयोग में लाई गई प्रबन्ध की अवधारणा थी:
questions.text_english: Sushant was an able Project Manager at 'Keiro Ltd.' Sushant's Head, Naveen handed over a new project to Sushant. Sushant already had enough work in hand. So, Sushant decided to divide the work assigned to him, among three of his subordinates. He himself kept that part of the work which he himself could perform effectively and got his subordinates to help him with what remained. The project got completed well in time because of this. The concept of management used by Sushant to complete the project was:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Delegation. Sushant divided the work among his subordinates while retaining some work for himself — this is the core essence of delegation, where a superior assigns part of his work and the related authority to his subordinates. Decentralization is a systematic delegation throughout the organisation; Accountability cannot be delegated; Authority alone does not describe the act of distributing work.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) अंतरण है। सुशांत ने अपना कार्य अधीनस्थों में बाँटा जबकि कुछ कार्य स्वयं रखा — यह अंतरण की मूल विशेषता है जिसमें वरिष्ठ अपना कार्य और संबंधित अधिकार अधीनस्थों को सौंपता है।

questions.text: 'अधिकारी का अपने अधीनस्थों में विश्वास का अभाव' सम्प्रेषण की बाधाओं में से एक है। सम्प्रेषण की बाधा को पहचानिए:
questions.text_english: 'Lack of confidence of superior in his subordinates' is one of the barriers of communication. Identify the communication barrier:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Personal barrier. Lack of confidence of a superior in his subordinates is a personal barrier to communication. Personal barriers arise due to personal factors of both sender and receiver such as lack of trust, unwillingness to communicate, fear of challenge to authority, etc. Psychological barriers relate to emotions and mental state; Semantic barriers involve words and language; Organizational barriers relate to structure and rules.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) व्यक्तिगत बाधा है। अधिकारी का अपने अधीनस्थों में विश्वास का अभाव एक व्यक्तिगत बाधा है जो प्रेषक और प्राप्तकर्ता के व्यक्तिगत कारकों जैसे अविश्वास, सम्प्रेषण की अनिच्छा आदि से उत्पन्न होती है।

questions.text: 'एक कम्पनी के समता अंशों में सार्वजनिक निर्गमन कम्पनी में प्रबन्ध की पकड़ को कमज़ोर करता है तथा इसे अपने अधिकार में लेने के लिए असुरक्षित बनाता है। यह कारक ऋण और समता के मध्य चयन को भी प्रभावित करता है विशेषकर उन कम्पनियों में जहाँ वर्तमान में प्रबन्ध की पकड़ कमज़ोर हालत में होती है।' उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित पूँजी ढाँचे के चयन को प्रभावित करने वाला कारक है:
questions.text_english: 'A public issue of equity may reduce the management holding in the company and make it vulnerable to takeover. This factor also influences the choice between debt and equity, especially in companies in which the current holding of management is on a lower side.' The factor affecting choice of capital structure discussed in the above case is:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Control. When a company issues equity shares publicly, the existing management's shareholding gets diluted, weakening their control and making the company vulnerable to hostile takeovers. Companies where management holding is already low prefer debt over equity to avoid further dilution of control. The passage clearly refers to the 'Control' factor in capital structure decisions.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) नियंत्रण है। जब कम्पनी सार्वजनिक रूप से समता अंश निर्गमित करती है, तो मौजूदा प्रबन्धन की हिस्सेदारी कम हो जाती है, जिससे उनका नियंत्रण कमज़ोर होता है और कम्पनी अधिग्रहण के प्रति संवेदनशील हो जाती है।

questions.text:
कथन I: नियंत्रण एक संगठन में योजनानुसार क्रियाओं का निष्पादन सुनिश्चित करता है।
कथन II: एक प्रबंधक का नियंत्रण कार्य सर्वव्यापी कार्य है।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Statement I: Controlling ensures that activities in an organization are performed as per the plans.
Statement II: Controlling function of a manager is a pervasive function.
Choose the correct option from the options given below:

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.B: कथन II सत्य है तथा कथन I असत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement II is true and Statement I is false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Both the Statements are true. Statement I is correct — controlling indeed ensures activities are performed as per the plans by comparing actual performance with standards and taking corrective action. Statement II is also correct — controlling is a pervasive function because it is performed by managers at all levels (top, middle, and lower) and in all departments of the organisation.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) दोनों कथन सत्य हैं। कथन I सही है — नियंत्रण वास्तविक प्रदर्शन की योजना से तुलना कर यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि क्रियाएँ योजनानुसार हों। कथन II भी सही है — नियंत्रण सर्वव्यापी है क्योंकि यह सभी स्तरों के प्रबंधकों द्वारा किया जाता है।

questions.text: 'लेंस-ओ' का आरम्भ आँखों के चश्मे व कॉन्टेक्ट लेंस की एक ऑनलाइन कम्पनी जो अपनी वेबसाइट पर विक्रय करती है, के रूप में किया गया था। हाल ही में इसने एक विशेष रूप से डिज़ाइन किया गया ऑफ़लाइन स्टोर आरम्भ किया है ताकि उपभोक्ता कम्पनी के शोरूम से भी उनके उत्पादों को क्रय कर सकें। कम्पनी द्वारा वितरण के किस माध्यम का उपयोग किया गया है:
questions.text_english: 'Lens-o' was started as an online eyewear company selling glasses and contact lenses on their website. Recently, it set up a uniquely designed offline store, so that customers can also buy their products from the company showroom. Which channel of distribution is used by the company:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Zero level channel. In a zero-level channel (also called direct channel), the manufacturer sells directly to the consumer without any intermediary. 'Lens-o' sells directly through its own website (online) and its own offline showroom — in both cases, there is no intermediary between the company and the customer. A one-level channel would involve a retailer, two-level would involve a wholesaler and retailer, etc.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) शून्य स्तरीय माध्यम है। शून्य स्तरीय माध्यम में निर्माता सीधे उपभोक्ता को बेचता है। 'लेंस-ओ' अपनी वेबसाइट और अपने शोरूम दोनों के माध्यम से सीधे उपभोक्ताओं को बेचती है — किसी बिचौलिए की भूमिका नहीं है।

questions.text: जुलाई, 2023 में सुनीता ने 'सुनीता ट्रेवल्स' नाम से अपनी एक ट्रेवल एजेंसी खोली। उसने आरक्षण, होटल बुकिंग, ऑनलाइन पूछताछ तथा भुगतान प्रबन्धन के लिए अलग-अलग विभाग बनाए। सुनीता द्वारा किस संगठन ढाँचे को उपयोग में लाया गया है:
questions.text_english: Sunita opened her travel agency named 'Sunita Travels' in July, 2023. She created separate departments for reservations, hotel bookings, online queries and payment handling. Which organisation structure is used by Sunita:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Functional structure. Sunita has organised her travel agency by creating separate departments based on functions — reservations, hotel bookings, online queries, and payment handling. This is the hallmark of a Functional organisation structure, where departments are created on the basis of different business functions. Divisional structure is created around product lines or geographical areas, not functions.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) कार्यात्मक ढाँचा है। सुनीता ने अपनी एजेंसी में कार्यों के आधार पर अलग-अलग विभाग बनाए हैं — यह कार्यात्मक संगठन ढाँचे की विशेषता है। प्रभागीय ढाँचे में विभाग उत्पाद या भौगोलिक क्षेत्र के आधार पर बनाए जाते हैं।

questions.text: 'जेकेएसडी इंडिया लिमिटेड' ने हाल ही में 'रसोई से ताज़ा' जैम, चटनी, सलाद मसाला तथा मूँगफली का मक्खन आदि की एक नई रेंज प्रस्तुत की है। बिक्री के उद्देश्य से इन्होंने विक्रयकर्ताओं की नियुक्ति की ताकि वे अग्रणी मॉल में भावी उपभोक्ताओं से सम्पर्क स्थापित कर उनके उत्पादों के संबंध में जागरूकता उत्पन्न कर सकें व उत्पाद की प्राथमिकता विकसित कर सकें। 'जेकेएसडी इंडिया लिमिटेड' द्वारा अपने उत्पादों के विपणन के लिए प्रवर्तन की किस तकनीक का उपयोग किया गया है:
questions.text_english: 'JKSD India Ltd.' recently introduced a new range of 'fresh from kitchen' jams, ketchups, salad dressings and peanut butter, etc. They appointed salespersons to contact prospective customers in leading malls to create awareness about their products and develop product preferences with the aim of making sales. Which tool of promotion is being used by 'JKSD India Ltd.' to market its products:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Personal Selling. JKSD India Ltd. appointed salespersons to personally meet and interact with prospective customers in malls to create awareness and develop product preferences — this is the defining characteristic of Personal Selling, which involves face-to-face interaction between salesperson and customer. Advertising is a mass impersonal medium; Sales Promotion involves short-term incentives; Public Relations involves managing the company's image.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) वैयक्तिक विक्रय है। जेकेएसडी ने विक्रयकर्ता नियुक्त किए जो मॉल में भावी उपभोक्ताओं से सीधे सम्पर्क करते हैं — यह वैयक्तिक विक्रय की पहचान है जिसमें विक्रेता और ग्राहक के बीच आमने-सामने संपर्क होता है।

questions.text: वे चयन परीक्षाएँ जिनका उपयोग व्यक्ति के नए कौशल को सीखने की संभावित कुशलता को मापने के लिए किया जाता है, कहलाती हैं:
questions.text_english: The selection tests which are used to measure individual's potential for learning new skills are called:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Aptitude Tests. Aptitude tests are designed to measure an individual's potential or capacity for learning new skills. They indicate whether a person has the natural ability to acquire certain skills with training. Intelligence tests measure general mental ability; Personality tests assess traits like temperament and emotional maturity; Interest tests assess a person's area of interest.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) कौशल परीक्षाएँ (Aptitude Tests) हैं। अभिक्षमता परीक्षाएँ व्यक्ति की नए कौशल सीखने की संभावित क्षमता को मापने के लिए उपयोग की जाती हैं। बुद्धि परीक्षाएँ सामान्य मानसिक क्षमता मापती हैं; व्यक्तित्व परीक्षाएँ व्यक्तित्व के गुणों को मापती हैं।

questions.text: वित्तीय बाज़ार निवेश के लिए उपलब्ध निधियों का आबंटन अथवा निर्देशन उनके सर्वाधिक उत्पादक निवेश अवसर में करता है। ऐसा करने पर वह _______________ कार्य निष्पादित करता है।
questions.text_english: Financial market allocates or directs funds available for investment into the most productive investment opportunity. In doing so, it performs the _____________ function.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Allocative. One of the key functions of financial markets is the Allocative function — directing available funds to the most productive investment opportunities. By channelling savings into the most efficient uses, financial markets ensure that capital is allocated where it earns the highest return, thereby promoting economic growth.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) आबंटनीय है। वित्तीय बाजार की आबंटनीय क्रिया का अर्थ है उपलब्ध निधियों को सर्वाधिक उत्पादक निवेश अवसर में निर्देशित करना, जिससे पूँजी का कुशल आवंटन होता है और आर्थिक विकास को बढ़ावा मिलता है।

questions.text: एक नाम, शब्द, चिह्न, प्रतीक अथवा इनमें से कुछ का मिश्रण, जिसका प्रयोग उत्पादों, वस्तुओं अथवा सेवाओं की पहचान बनाने के लिए तथा एक विक्रेता अथवा विक्रेताओं के एक समूह की वस्तुओं अथवा सेवाओं का प्रतियोगियों के उत्पादों से अन्तर्भेद करने के लिए किया जाता है, जाना जाता है:
questions.text_english: A name, term, symbol, design, or some combination of these, used to identify the products, goods or services of one seller or group of sellers and to differentiate them from those of the competitors is known as:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Brand. A Brand is a comprehensive term that includes a name, term, symbol, design, or combination used to identify a seller's goods/services and differentiate them from competitors. Brand Name refers only to the verbal/pronounceable part; Brand Mark is the visual symbol or design part; Trade Mark is a legally registered brand name or brand mark.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) ब्राण्ड है। ब्राण्ड एक व्यापक शब्द है जिसमें नाम, शब्द, चिह्न, प्रतीक या इनका संयोजन शामिल है। ब्राण्ड नाम केवल उच्चारणीय भाग है; ब्राण्ड मार्क दृश्य प्रतीक है; ट्रेड मार्क कानूनी रूप से पंजीकृत ब्राण्ड है।

questions.text: 'स्थायी वित्त व्यय जैसे ब्याज की उपस्थिति के कारण समता अंशधारियों द्वारा अर्जित लाभ में वृद्धि' को उल्लिखित किया जाता है:
questions.text_english: Increase in profit earned by equity shareholders due to the presence of fixed financial charges like interest is referred to as:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Trading on equity. Trading on equity refers to the increase in the earnings per share of equity shareholders due to the use of fixed interest-bearing debt (like debentures or loans). When a company earns a higher rate of return on borrowed funds than the interest it pays, the surplus profit goes to equity shareholders, increasing their earnings.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) समता पर व्यापार है। समता पर व्यापार से आशय है कि स्थिर ब्याज वाले ऋण के उपयोग के कारण समता अंशधारियों की प्रति अंश आय में वृद्धि होना। जब कम्पनी उधार ली गई राशि पर अदा किए जाने वाले ब्याज से अधिक दर पर अर्जन करती है, तो अतिरिक्त लाभ समता अंशधारियों को मिलता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी विपणन की एक विशेषता नहीं है:
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not a feature of marketing:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Storage and warehousing. Storage and warehousing is a function of physical distribution or logistics management, not a feature or core characteristic of marketing itself. The features of marketing include focusing on needs and wants (A), creating customer value (C), and creating a market offering (D). Marketing is fundamentally about identifying and satisfying customer needs profitably.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) संग्रहण एवं भंडारण है। संग्रहण एवं भंडारण भौतिक वितरण/लॉजिस्टिक्स का कार्य है, विपणन की विशेषता नहीं। विपणन की विशेषताओं में अपेक्षा एवं आवश्यकता, ग्राहक मूल्य और उत्पाद का सृजन शामिल हैं।

questions.text:
पीयूष एक जूता बनाने वाली कम्पनी 'कम्फटी' का उत्पादन प्रबन्धक है। उसके विभाग में उसके अधीन 1000 कर्मचारी कार्यरत हैं। पीयूष ने 300 जोड़ी पुरुष जूतों का एक विशेष आदेश ₹ 500 की अनुमानित लागत जमा 20% लाभ उपांत पर पंजीकृत किया। आदेश की पूर्ति 10 दिनों में की जानी है। आदेश के पूरा होने के बाद पीयूष ने पाया कि एक जोड़ी जूते की उत्पादन लागत ₹ 600 थी। उसने कारण का पता लगाने की कोशिश की लेकिन वह कारण नहीं पता लगा सका। उसने इसकी सूचना मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी को दी। मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी ने कारण का पता लगाने के लिए अभय को नियुक्त किया। अभय न केवल एक विशिष्ट लागत लेखाकार था अपितु एक योग्य मानव संसाधन प्रबन्धक भी था। दो दिन के बाद अभय ने सूचित किया कि निश्चित लक्ष्यों को केवल 800 कर्मचारियों की सहायता से पूरा किया जा सकता था, जिससे यह परिलक्षित हुआ कि संगठन में कर्मचारियों का आधिक्य था। संगठन मानव संसाधन का अनुकूलतम उपयोग नहीं कर पा रहा था जिससे श्रम लागत बढ़ गई।
उपर्युक्त स्थिति प्रबन्ध के एक महत्त्वपूर्ण कार्य के महत्त्व के एक बिन्दु पर प्रकाश डाल रही है।
(i) प्रबन्ध के कार्य की पहचान कीजिए।
(ii) उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित महत्त्व के बिन्दु के अतिरिक्त भाग (i) में पहचाने गए प्रबन्ध के कार्य के महत्त्व के किन्हीं दो बिन्दुओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
Piyush is the Production Manager of a shoe company called 'Comforty'. He has 1000 workers working under him in his department. Piyush booked a special order for 300 pairs of gents shoes at an estimated cost price of ₹ 500 per pair plus 20% profit margin. The order is to be completed within 10 days. After completion of the order, Piyush found out that the production cost of one pair of shoes was ₹ 600. He tried to find out the reason, but he couldn't. He reported it to the Chief Executive Officer. The Chief Executive Officer appointed Abhay to find out the cause. Abhay was not only a specialized Cost Accountant, but also a qualified Human Resource Manager. After two days, Abhay reported that the set targets could be completed with the help of only 800 workers, which revealed that there was overmanning in the organization. The organization was not utilizing the human resources optimally, which had led to higher labour cost.
The above case highlights one of the points of importance of an important function of management.
(i) Identify the function of management.
(ii) State any two points of importance of the function of management identified in part (i), except the one discussed in the above case.

sub_questions.text: प्रबन्ध के कार्य की पहचान कीजिए।

key_points: Staffing

sub_questions.solution: The function of management highlighted in the above case is Staffing. The case reveals that the organisation had overmanning — 1000 workers were employed when only 800 were needed to complete the targets. This indicates poor staffing decisions, as Staffing involves estimating the manpower requirements and ensuring optimal utilisation of human resources.

sub_questions.text: उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित महत्त्व के बिन्दु के अतिरिक्त भाग (i) में पहचाने गए प्रबन्ध के कार्य के महत्त्व के किन्हीं दो बिन्दुओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any two points of importance of the function of management identified in part (i), except the one discussed in the above case.

key_points: Staffing helps in finding competent personnel — it ensures the right person is placed in the right job at the right time.
Staffing improves job satisfaction and morale — proper placement, training, and development lead to employee motivation and satisfaction.

sub_questions.solution: Two important points of Staffing (other than optimal utilisation of human resources discussed in the case) are: First, Staffing helps to find and place competent personnel by ensuring that the right person with the right qualifications is placed in the right position, which leads to efficient organisational performance. Second, Staffing helps in developing human resources through proper training and development programmes, thereby improving skills, knowledge, and capabilities of employees for present and future roles.

key_points: Function identified: Staffing
Importance point 1: Ensures right person at right place (proper placement of human resources)
Importance point 2: Human resource development through training

questions.solution:
(i) The function of management is Staffing. The case reveals overmanning — 1000 workers employed when 800 were sufficient, reflecting poor manpower planning.

(ii) Two other points of importance of Staffing: First, Staffing ensures that competent and qualified personnel are placed in the right positions within the organisation, which directly contributes to achieving organisational goals efficiently. Second, Staffing facilitates the development of human resources by organising proper training and development programmes, enhancing employees' skills and preparing them for higher responsibilities in the future.

questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से किसी एक का उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer any one of the following:

sub_questions.text: प्रबन्ध के 'नियंत्रण' कार्य के महत्त्व के किन्हीं तीन बिन्दुओं को समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any three points of importance of Controlling function of management.

key_points: Controlling helps in accomplishing organisational goals by keeping activities on track.
Controlling makes efficient use of resources by ensuring no wastage.
Controlling facilitates coordination by linking all departments to a common standard.

sub_questions.solution: Three points of importance of the Controlling function of management are as follows. First, Controlling helps in accomplishing organisational goals — it keeps all activities aligned with the planned objectives and takes corrective action whenever there is a deviation, thereby ensuring that the organisation moves in the right direction. Second, Controlling helps in making efficient use of resources — by monitoring performance and eliminating wastage, controlling ensures that all human, financial, and physical resources are used optimally without unnecessary expenditure. Third, Controlling facilitates coordination — it acts as a connecting link between all departments by establishing common standards and ensuring that every department's activities contribute towards achieving organisational goals.

sub_questions.text: किन्हीं तीन बिन्दुओं की सहायता से प्रबन्ध के 'नियोजन' एवं 'नियंत्रण' कार्यों के बीच संबंध को समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the relationship between 'Planning' and 'Controlling' functions of management with the help of any three points.

key_points: Planning provides standards against which actual performance is measured during controlling.
Controlling provides feedback which is used to improve future planning.
They are interdependent — planning without controlling is meaningless and controlling without planning has no basis.

sub_questions.solution: The relationship between Planning and Controlling can be understood through three points. First, Planning provides the basis for Controlling — planning sets the objectives, targets, and standards, and controlling compares actual performance against these predetermined standards to find deviations. Without a plan, there is nothing to control. Second, Controlling provides feedback for Planning — the deviations found during controlling reveal the weaknesses in the existing plans, which helps managers improve future plans and set more realistic targets. Third, they form a cycle — planning and controlling are interdependent and mutually reinforcing. Planning is the beginning of the management process and controlling is the last step, but the feedback from controlling loops back into planning, making the two functions inseparable.

questions.solution: This is an either/or question. Refer to sub-questions (a) and (b) for complete model answers.

questions.text: कक्षा XII में उद्यमिता की पढ़ाई करने के बाद नील ने बेकरी का एक पाठ्यक्रम पूरा किया और 'केक्स एंड बेक्स' एक बेकरी की दुकान प्रारंभ की। उसने पहले वर्ष में निवेश पर 10% प्रतिफल प्राप्ति का एक साधारण लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया। चूँकि वह बेकरी स्वास्थ्यवर्धक उत्पाद की आपूर्ति कर रही थी, अत: माँग लगातार बढ़ रही थी। एक ही वर्ष में 'केक्स एंड बेक्स' एक प्रसिद्ध बेकरी बन गई। अब वह दीर्घ अवधि के लिए 'केक्स एंड बेक्स' की दिशा एवं सीमा परिभाषित करने के लिए योजना विकसित करना चाहता था। यह निर्णय लेने के लिए कि क्या वह निवेश पर प्रतिफल को बढ़ाने के लिए ऊँचे मूल्य ले सकता है, तथा उत्पादों का विज्ञापन किस प्रकार किया जाए, आदि के लिए उसने एक विपणन योजना बनाई। उपर्युक्त अनुच्छेद से पंक्तियों को उद्धृत करते हुए उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित दो प्रकार की योजनाओं को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english: After studying Entrepreneurship in Class XII, Neel completed a baking course and started a bakery, 'Cakes and Bakes'. He set a target of earning a modest 10% return on investment in the first year. As he was supplying healthy bakery products, the demand kept increasing. 'Cakes and Bakes' became a famous bakery in a year. He now wanted to develop a plan to define the direction and scope of 'Cakes and Bakes' for the long run. He made a marketing plan to decide if he could charge higher price to improve his return on investment, how to advertise the products, etc. Quoting lines from the above paragraph, identify and explain two types of plans discussed in the above case.

key_points: Strategy — 'develop a plan to define the direction and scope of Cakes and Bakes for the long run'
Policy / Objective — 'a target of earning a modest 10% return on investment in the first year'
Strategy explanation — a comprehensive long-term plan specifying direction of the organisation
Objective explanation — specific measurable end result that guides action

questions.solution:
Two types of plans discussed in the above case are:

1. Objective: The line 'He set a target of earning a modest 10% return on investment in the first year' indicates an Objective. An Objective is the end result which the organisation wishes to achieve within a specific time period. Objectives are specific, measurable, and time-bound. Here, Neel's objective was to earn 10% return on investment in the first year, which directed all his actions.

2. Strategy: The line 'He now wanted to develop a plan to define the direction and scope of Cakes and Bakes for the long run' indicates a Strategy. A Strategy is a comprehensive plan that defines the long-term direction, scope, and position of the organisation in its environment. It guides major decisions about how to deploy resources to achieve objectives. Neel's marketing plan (regarding pricing and advertising) is part of this strategic planning.

questions.text: 'इनाया लिमिटेड' एक बहुराष्ट्रीय तकनीकी कम्पनी है जिसका केन्द्र-बिन्दु कृत्रिम बुद्धिमता (आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस), ऑनलाइन विज्ञापन व सर्च इंजन तकनीक है। कम्पनी अच्छे लाभ अर्जित कर रही है और अपने स्टॉफ का भली-भाँति ध्यान रखती है। कम्पनी प्रबन्धक स्तर के ऊपर के सभी कर्मचारियों को कार भत्ता, चिकित्सा सहायता व बच्चों की शिक्षा के लिए भत्ता जैसे लाभ प्रस्तावित करती है। वह अपने कर्मचारियों की भविष्य निधि में नियमित रूप से अंशदान करती है तथा उनकी सेवानिवृत्ति पर आनुतोषिक (ग्रेच्युटी) का भुगतान करती है। एक विशेष प्रोत्साहन योजना के अन्तर्गत इसके कर्मचारियों को एक निश्चित मूल्य पर, जो कि बाज़ार मूल्य से कम होता है, 'इनाया लिमिटेड' के अंश भी प्रस्तावित करती है। प्रति वर्ष कम्पनी अपने कोषों का एक भाग अलग रखती है ताकि कर्मचारियों को आधारभूत वेतन के एक प्रतिशत का बोनस के रूप में भुगतान कर सके। कोई आश्चर्य की बात नहीं है कि 90% कर्मचारी किसी मित्र को 'इनाया लिमिटेड' में कार्य करने के लिए सिफारिश करेंगे। अच्छे निष्पादन के लिए अपने कर्मचारियों को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए 'इनाया लिमिटेड' द्वारा प्रदान किए जाने वाले चार प्रोत्साहनों को समझाइए।
questions.text_english: 'Inaya Ltd.' is a multinational technology company focusing on artificial intelligence, online advertising and search engine technology. The company is generating good profits and takes care of the well-being of its staff. The company offers benefits like car allowance, medical aid and allowance for children's education to all employees above the Manager's level. It regularly contributes towards the Employees' Provident Fund and pays gratuity on retirement to its employees. Under a special incentive scheme, the employees are offered shares of 'Inaya Ltd.' at a set price which is lower than the market price. Each year, the company keeps aside funds to pay one percent of base salary as bonus to its employees. No wonder 90% of the employees would recommend working at 'Inaya Ltd.' to a friend. Explain four incentives being provided by 'Inaya Ltd.' to motivate their employees for better performance.

key_points: Perquisites/Fringe Benefits — car allowance, medical aid, education allowance
Retirement Benefits — Provident Fund contributions and Gratuity
Co-partnership/Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) — shares offered at below market price
Bonus — one percent of base salary paid as bonus

questions.solution:
Four incentives provided by Inaya Ltd. to motivate employees are:

1. Perquisites/Fringe Benefits: The company offers car allowance, medical aid, and allowance for children's education to all employees above the Manager's level. These are non-monetary benefits over and above the regular salary that satisfy employees' security and comfort needs, motivating them to stay with the company.

2. Retirement Benefits: Inaya Ltd. regularly contributes to the Employees' Provident Fund and pays Gratuity at the time of retirement. These financial security benefits assure employees of their post-retirement wellbeing, which motivates them to serve the company loyally over a long period.

3. Co-partnership / ESOP (Employee Stock Option Plan): Under a special incentive scheme, employees are offered shares of Inaya Ltd. at a price lower than the prevailing market price. This gives employees a sense of ownership and a direct stake in the company's profits, making them work harder for the company's success.

4. Bonus: Each year, the company sets aside funds to pay a bonus of one percent of base salary to its employees. Bonus is a financial incentive that rewards good performance and motivates employees to achieve targets and contribute to the company's profitability.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain 'Vestibule Training' and 'Apprenticeship Programme' as methods of training.

key_points: Vestibule Training — simulated work environment away from actual workplace
Apprenticeship Programme — learning under the guidance of a skilled craftsman for a specified period

sub_questions.solution:
Vestibule Training: In this method, training is imparted in a special classroom set up away from the actual workplace. The environment created closely resembles the actual work setting with the same tools, equipment, and conditions. The trainee learns the job in this simulated environment without disturbing the actual production process. It is particularly useful for jobs that require the use of special equipment or machinery, such as in factories. The advantage is that trainees can make mistakes and learn from them without disrupting real operations.

Apprenticeship Programme: This programme is designed to impart skills related to crafts, trades, or technical areas. The trainee is placed under the guidance of an experienced and skilled master worker (craftsman or supervisor) for a fixed period. During this period, the trainee works alongside the expert and learns the skills through direct observation and practice. Upon successful completion, the trainee earns a certificate. Examples include plumbers, electricians, and carpenters who learn through apprenticeship.

key_points: It is economical as it saves recruitment and training costs.
It motivates existing employees by providing growth opportunities.
It reduces the time needed for employee orientation and induction.
It promotes loyalty and reduces employee turnover.

sub_questions.solution: Four advantages of internal sources of recruitment are as follows. First, it is economical — internal recruitment saves costs related to advertising, external search, and extensive induction training because the employee already knows the organisation. Second, it is a source of motivation — promotions from within motivate existing employees to work harder as they see clear opportunities for career growth and advancement in the same organisation. Third, the process is simpler and faster — since the candidate is already known to the organisation, the selection process requires less time, and the employee needs minimal orientation as they are already familiar with the organisation's culture, policies, and procedures. Fourth, it promotes loyalty — employees who see a future in the organisation tend to be more loyal, committed, and less likely to leave, thereby reducing employee turnover.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following factors affecting the requirements of fixed capital:
(i) Scale of operations
(ii) Financing alternatives

key_points: Scale of operations — larger scale requires more fixed capital investment in plant and machinery
Financing alternatives — availability of leasing or hire-purchase reduces outright fixed capital requirement

sub_questions.solution:
(i) Scale of operations: The size and scale at which a business operates is one of the most significant factors affecting fixed capital requirements. A business operating on a large scale needs heavy investment in fixed assets such as plant, machinery, land, and buildings to support high-volume production. On the contrary, a small-scale business requires comparatively lesser fixed capital as it operates with limited capacity and fewer fixed assets. For example, a large automobile manufacturer needs far more fixed capital than a small repair workshop.

(ii) Financing alternatives: The availability of financing alternatives significantly affects fixed capital requirements. If a business can use alternatives such as leasing, hire-purchase, or outsourcing rather than purchasing fixed assets outright, its fixed capital requirement reduces substantially. For instance, if a company leases its machinery instead of purchasing it, the immediate requirement of fixed capital is lowered. Thus, the availability of such alternatives reduces the need for large investment in fixed assets.

लाभांश निर्णय को प्रभावित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कारकों को समझाइए:

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following factors affecting dividend decision:
(i) Cash flow position
(ii) Growth opportunities

key_points: Cash flow position — better cash flow allows higher dividend payments
Growth opportunities — companies with high growth plans retain more profits and pay less dividend

sub_questions.solution:
(i) Cash flow position: Dividend payment requires actual cash outflow. A company may earn high profits but still have a poor cash flow position due to high receivables or other obligations. Therefore, the actual cash available in the business significantly affects the dividend decision. A company with a strong and stable cash flow position can afford to declare higher dividends, while a company facing a cash crunch may prefer to retain profits and declare little or no dividend, even if it has reported profits on paper.

(ii) Growth opportunities: Companies that have significant growth plans and expansion opportunities tend to retain a larger portion of their earnings rather than distributing them as dividends. This is because internal funds are one of the cheapest sources of financing growth. Retained profits are reinvested to fund new projects, research, or capacity expansion. Hence, companies with more growth opportunities tend to pay lower dividends, while companies with limited growth opportunities distribute a higher proportion of profits as dividends.

questions.text: किन्हीं चार आधारों पर प्राथमिक बाज़ार एवं द्वितीयक बाज़ार में अन्तर्भेद कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Distinguish between Primary Market and Secondary Market on any four bases.

key_points: Meaning: Primary market deals in new/fresh issue of securities; Secondary market deals in existing/already-issued securities.
Participants: In Primary market, securities are bought directly from the company; in Secondary market, securities are bought and sold between investors.
Prices: Prices in Primary market are fixed by the company; in Secondary market, prices are determined by demand and supply forces.
Finance flow: In Primary market, funds flow from investors to the company; in Secondary market, funds flow between investors.

questions.solution:
Distinction between Primary Market and Secondary Market on four bases:

1. Meaning: The Primary Market (also called the New Issue Market) deals with fresh issue of securities, where companies raise new capital by issuing shares or debentures for the first time. The Secondary Market (also called the Stock Exchange) is a market where existing, already-issued securities are bought and sold between investors.

2. Who buys: In the Primary Market, securities are sold directly by the issuing company to investors (via IPO, FPO, etc.). In the Secondary Market, securities are traded between investors themselves — no new securities are created.

3. Price determination: In the Primary Market, the price of securities is determined by the issuing company (or through book-building). In the Secondary Market, prices are determined by market forces of demand and supply, which fluctuate continuously.

4. Flow of funds: In the Primary Market, the funds raised go directly to the company issuing the securities, helping it raise capital for expansion. In the Secondary Market, funds flow from one investor to another; the company does not receive any funds from these transactions.

questions.text: अश्विन एक फ़ैशन डिज़ाइनर था। अपनी नौकरी छूट जाने पर उसने ब्राण्ड नाम 'कोग' के अन्तर्गत ऑनलाइन डिज़ाइनर कपड़े बेचने का निर्णय लिया। वस्त्र अच्छी गुणवत्ता वाले कपड़ों के साथ जटिल डिज़ाइनों एवं कुशल शिल्प कौशल के कारण उत्पादित करने में बहुत महँगे पड़ रहे थे। यह अनुभव करने के बाद कि ऑनलाइन बाज़ार अत्यधिक प्रतियोगी है, उसने निर्णय लिया कि वह वस्त्रों के लिए एक उचित मूल्य वसूल करेगा। यह मूल्य वस्त्रों की उत्पादन एवं विक्रय लागत पूरी करेगा और साथ ही उसे इस लागत के अतिरिक्त 10% उपांत भी देगा। उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित मूल्य निर्धारण को प्रभावित करने वाले दो कारकों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english: Ashwin was a fashion designer. On losing his job, he decided to sell the designer clothes online under the brand name 'Kogue'. The garments were made of good quality fabric with intricate designs and skilled craftsmanship, making them expensive to produce. Realizing that the online market is very competitive, he decided to charge a reasonable price for the garments. The price would cover the cost of production and sale of garments as well as give him 10% margin over and above the cost. Identify and explain two factors affecting the price determination discussed in the above case.

key_points: Cost of production — high cost of fabric, design, and craftsmanship drives the price upward
Competition — highly competitive online market forces charging a 'reasonable' price

questions.solution:
Two factors affecting price determination in the above case are:

1. Cost of Production/Product: The case states that 'The garments were made of good quality fabric with intricate designs and skilled craftsmanship, making them expensive to produce.' This highlights Cost as a major factor affecting price. Cost sets the floor below which the price cannot be set, as the business must cover its production and selling costs. Ashwin decided to price his clothes so that they cover the cost of production and sale, plus give him a 10% profit margin. Thus, higher production costs led to a higher minimum price.

2. Competition: The case mentions that 'Realizing that the online market is very competitive, he decided to charge a reasonable price.' The degree of competition in the market is a key external factor influencing price. In a highly competitive market, a seller cannot charge prices that are much higher than those of competitors. To remain competitive in the crowded online fashion market, Ashwin chose to set a reasonable (not excessively high) price, showing how competition acts as a ceiling on the prices that can be charged.

questions.text:
'वी.बी.आर. सिनेमा,' एक भारतीय मल्टी-प्लेक्स सिनेमा हॉल था जिसने पहली बार लोगों की उपभोग प्रवृत्तियों में परिवर्तन की पहचान की। इसने अपने भोजन के मेन्यू में से बर्गर, पिज़्ज़ा, शीतल पेय आदि को सलाद, स्मूदीस्, सूप और अंजीर-आधारित मिठाइयों जैसे स्वास्थ्यप्रद विकल्पों में बदल दिया। एक ही माह में खाद्य वस्तुओं की बिक्री से मल्टी-प्लेक्स का आगम दुगुना हो गया।

questions.text_english:
'VBR Cinema', an Indian multiplex cinema hall was the first to recognize the change in consumption habits of people. It changed its food menu from burgers, pizza, soft drinks, etc. and switched over to healthier options like salads and smoothies, soups and anjeer-based sweets. Within a month, the revenue of the multiplex from sale of food items doubled.
'VBR Cinema', by continuously monitoring the environment and adopting suitable business practices, was able to improve its revenues and profits and was hopeful that it will continue to succeed in the market in the long run too.
Identify and explain one dimension of business environment and one point of importance of understanding the business environment highlighted in the above case.

key_points: Dimension: Social environment — change in consumption habits/health consciousness of people
Importance: Helps in identifying opportunities and threats — recognising the trend early helped VBR double its revenue

questions.solution:
Dimension of Business Environment identified: Social/Societal Environment.
The case highlights a change in the social dimension of business environment — people's consumption habits shifted towards healthier food choices (salads, smoothies, soups) away from burgers, pizza, and soft drinks. The Social environment includes attitudes, values, customs, and lifestyles of the society in which the business operates. VBR Cinema identified this social change and adapted its menu accordingly.

Point of Importance of Understanding Business Environment: Identification of Opportunities and Threats.
The case shows that 'VBR Cinema was the first to recognise the change in consumption habits of people.' By continuously monitoring the environment, VBR identified an early-mover opportunity in health-conscious food. Understanding the business environment helps a firm identify opportunities (growing demand for healthy food) and threats (declining demand for junk food) before competitors, and act upon them swiftly. This enabled VBR to double its food revenue within a month, giving it a first-mover competitive advantage.

questions.text: नलिनी का फूलों एवं उपहारों का एक ऑनलाइन फुटकर व्यवसाय है। भारत के चार शहरों में इसके आठ विक्रय-केन्द्र हैं। नवम्बर से फरवरी तक, शादी के मौसम में माँग बहुत अधिक बढ़ जाती है। वह जून के महीने में ही अपने कर्मचारियों के प्रयासों को ध्यानपूर्वक एवं सोच-समझकर समन्वित करती है और शादी के मौसम की माँग के बारे में योजनाएँ बना लेती हैं। वह यह सुनिश्चित करती है कि उसके पास पर्याप्त कार्यबल हो और निरन्तर इस बात पर नज़र रखती है कि कार्य योजनाओं के अनुरूप आगे बढ़ रहा है। वह विपणन विभाग को इस बात का संक्षिप्त वृत्तान्त देती है कि वे समय पर अपने प्रवर्तन एवं विज्ञापन अभियान तैयार कर लें। अत: संगठन के सभी विभागों के साथ उसका समन्वय नियोजन स्तर पर आरम्भ हो जाता है और नियंत्रण तक निरन्तर चलता रहता है। यह विभिन्न विभागों को जोड़ने की शक्ति का कार्य करता है और यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि सभी क्रियाएँ संगठन के लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए की जाएँ। परिणामस्वरूप, नलिनी समूह के प्रयासों को एक केन्द्र-बिन्दु प्रदान करती है और यह सुनिश्चित करती है कि वर्ष-दर-वर्ष व्यवसाय का निष्पादन योजनानुसार हो। उपर्युक्त अनुच्छेद से पंक्तियों को उद्धृत करते हुए, उपर्युक्त स्थिति में दर्शाई गई प्रबन्ध की एक महत्त्वपूर्ण अवधारणा की चार विशेषताओं को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english:
Nalini has an online flower and gifts retail business. She has eight outlets in four cities of India. From November to February, during the wedding season, the demand shoots up. She coordinates the efforts of her staff in a conscious and deliberate manner and plans for the wedding season demand in the month of June itself. She ensures that there is adequate workforce and continuously monitors whether work is proceeding according to plans. She also briefs the marketing department in time to prepare their promotional and advertising campaigns. Thus, her coordination with all departments of the organization begins at the planning stage and continues till controlling. This acts as a binding force between the departments and ensures that all action is aimed at achieving organizational goals. As a result, Nalini is able to give a common focus to group effort to ensure that the business is performing as planned, year after year.
Quoting lines from the above paragraph, identify and explain four features of an important concept of management highlighted in the above case.

key_points: Concept: Coordination
Feature 1: Coordination is the essence/core of management — it runs from planning to controlling
Feature 2: Coordination is a conscious and deliberate activity
Feature 3: Coordination is a continuous process
Feature 4: Coordination ensures unity of action / gives common focus to group effort

questions.solution:
The important concept of management highlighted in the above case is Coordination. Four features of Coordination identified from the paragraph are:

1. Coordination is a deliberate function: The line 'She coordinates the efforts of her staff in a conscious and deliberate manner' highlights that coordination does not happen on its own — it requires conscious and deliberate effort by the manager. It is not automatic; managers must actively work to bring together the various activities and efforts of people.

2. Coordination is a continuous process: The line 'her coordination with all departments of the organization begins at the planning stage and continues till controlling' highlights that coordination is not a one-time activity. It is a continuous process that begins at the planning stage and goes on throughout all functions of management until controlling, ensuring that activities remain aligned with objectives at every stage.

3. Coordination is the binding force / acts as a linking pin: The line 'This acts as a binding force between the departments' highlights that coordination links all the different departments and functions of an organisation together. It ensures that the efforts of separate departments do not conflict but are directed towards common goals, holding the organisation together.

4. Coordination ensures unity of effort / common focus: The line 'Nalini is able to give a common focus to group effort to ensure that the business is performing as planned, year after year' highlights that the ultimate purpose of coordination is to achieve unity of action. By aligning individual and departmental efforts towards common organisational objectives, coordination ensures that the organisation consistently achieves its planned targets.

(i) विज्ञान, न कि अँगूठा टेक नियम
(ii) सहयोग, न कि टकराव
(iii) प्रत्येक व्यक्ति का उसकी अधिकाधिक क्षमता एवं समृद्धि के लिए विकास
sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following principles of Scientific Management:
(i) Science, Not Rule of Thumb
(ii) Harmony, Not Discord
(iii) Development of Each and Every Person to His or Her Greatest Efficiency and Prosperity

key_points: Science, Not Rule of Thumb — replace guesswork with scientific methods in every aspect of management
Harmony, Not Discord — complete harmony between workers and management through mental revolution
Development of each person — training each worker to reach their fullest potential

sub_questions.solution:
(i) Science, Not Rule of Thumb: Taylor advocated that scientific methods should be used to perform every task in the organisation, replacing the old and traditional method of 'Rule of Thumb' (doing things by guesswork or based on personal experience). Under this principle, all work should be scientifically analysed — time and motion studies should be conducted to determine the best method of performing each task, the exact time needed, and the most efficient use of resources. For example, instead of allowing each worker to decide how to use a shovel, Taylor conducted experiments to find the optimal shovel size that maximised output per worker.

(ii) Harmony, Not Discord: Taylor believed that there should be complete harmony between workers and management, rather than conflict and discord. Both management and workers should recognise each other's importance. Taylor proposed a 'mental revolution' — a complete change in the attitude and outlook of both parties. Management should share the gains of increased productivity with workers, and workers should work wholeheartedly towards the organisation's goals. This mutual trust and cooperation would benefit both parties and eliminate the adversarial relationship.

(iii) Development of Each and Every Person to His or Her Greatest Efficiency and Prosperity: Taylor believed that the principal objective of management should be to ensure maximum prosperity for both the employer and the employees. To achieve this, each worker must be trained to develop their skills to the fullest possible extent. The right person should be placed in the right job after identifying their aptitudes and abilities. Through proper training and development, each individual should be helped to reach their greatest efficiency, which ultimately increases their earning potential and promotes their personal prosperity.

sub_questions.text:
प्रबन्ध के सिद्धान्तों के महत्त्व के निम्नलिखित बिन्दुओं को समझाइए:
(i) प्रबन्धकों को वास्तविकता का उपयोगी सूक्ष्म ज्ञान प्रदान करना
(ii) वैज्ञानिक निर्णय
(iii) सामाजिक उत्तरदायित्वों को पूरा करना
sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following points of significance of principles of management:
(i) Providing managers with useful insights into reality
(ii) Scientific decisions
(iii) Fulfilling social responsibility

key_points: Provides insights — principles increase managerial awareness and understanding of complex situations
Scientific decisions — principles replace personal bias with objective, fact-based decision making
Social responsibility — principles guide managers to act in the broader interests of society

sub_questions.solution:
(i) Providing managers with useful insights into reality: Principles of management are derived from years of practical experience and research. They increase managers' knowledge and understanding of managerial situations, enabling them to handle complex and difficult situations more effectively. Without these principles, managers would have to rely purely on trial-and-error, which is costly and time-consuming. Principles provide a conceptual framework that helps managers understand the cause-and-effect relationships in organisational behaviour, thereby improving the quality of managerial decisions.

(ii) Scientific decisions: Principles of management enable managers to take decisions on the basis of objective analysis and facts rather than on personal judgement, bias, or intuition. They provide a systematic and rational basis for decision making. When a manager applies a well-tested principle to a management problem, the decision reached is more likely to be correct, consistent, and fair. This reduces uncertainty in decision making and improves the overall quality of outcomes in the organisation.

(iii) Fulfilling social responsibility: Principles of management act as a guide for managers to meet their social responsibilities towards various stakeholders including employees, customers, and the community. Principles such as Fayol's 'Equity' (fair treatment of employees), 'Initiative' (encouraging employee creativity), and 'Esprit de Corps' (team spirit) promote a positive organisational culture and ethical conduct. By following these principles, managers not only achieve organisational goals but also contribute to the welfare of society at large, thereby fulfilling their social obligations.

questions.solution: This is an either/or question. Refer to sub-questions (a) and (b) for complete model answers.

sub_questions.text: किन्हीं छः आधारों पर 'औपचारिक संगठन' एवं 'अनौपचारिक संगठन' में अन्तर्भेद कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Differentiate between 'Formal Organization' and 'Informal Organization' on any six bases.

key_points: Meaning: Formal — deliberately created structure; Informal — emerges naturally from social interaction
Authority: Formal — flows through official hierarchy; Informal — no official chain of command
Rules: Formal — bound by rules and policies; Informal — based on customs and norms
Communication: Formal — follows official channels; Informal — grapevine communication
Focus: Formal — task/work-oriented; Informal — people/social-oriented
Stability: Formal — stable and defined; Informal — unstable and informal

sub_questions.solution:
Distinction between Formal Organisation and Informal Organisation on six bases:

1. Meaning: A Formal Organisation is one that is deliberately and officially created by management to achieve organisational goals. It has a well-defined structure, clear roles, responsibilities, and authority relationships. An Informal Organisation is one that emerges spontaneously as a result of personal interactions, social relationships, and common interests among employees — it is not deliberately created by management.

2. Origin: A Formal Organisation is created by management through a conscious decision to structure the organisation. An Informal Organisation comes into being naturally and is not planned or designed.

3. Authority: In a Formal Organisation, authority flows through the official hierarchy — from top to bottom through the chain of command. In an Informal Organisation, there is no fixed authority structure; influence is exercised through personal relationships and social standing.

4. Rules and Regulations: A Formal Organisation is governed by a defined set of rules, regulations, and procedures laid down by management. An Informal Organisation is governed by social norms, customs, and group values which are unwritten and implicit.

5. Communication: In a Formal Organisation, communication follows official channels (upward, downward, lateral) as prescribed by the organisation. In an Informal Organisation, communication takes place through informal channels (grapevine), which can move in any direction rapidly.

6. Focus: A Formal Organisation is primarily work-oriented and focused on achieving the official goals of the organisation. An Informal Organisation is people-oriented, focusing on the social needs and interests of its members.

sub_questions.text: प्रबन्ध के 'नियोजन' कार्य के महत्त्व के किन्हीं चार बिन्दुओं को समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any four points of importance of 'Planning' function of management.

key_points: Planning provides direction — tells everyone what needs to be done
Planning reduces the risk of uncertainty — anticipates future events
Planning promotes innovative ideas — thinking ahead generates creative solutions
Planning facilitates decision making — pre-decided objectives guide choices

sub_questions.solution:
Four points of importance of the Planning function of management are:

1. Provides direction: Planning sets the goals and objectives of the organisation in advance, thereby providing a sense of direction to all members of the organisation. Everyone knows what needs to be done, when, and how. Without planning, activities would be haphazard and people would work at cross purposes.

2. Reduces the risk of uncertainty: Business operates in a dynamic and uncertain environment. Planning helps managers anticipate future events, foresee changes, and prepare in advance to deal with them. By deciding in advance what to do under different possible circumstances, planning reduces the risk associated with uncertainty and helps the organisation navigate change more smoothly.

3. Promotes innovative ideas: Planning is the first function of management that requires creative and forward-looking thinking. The process of setting goals and deciding how to achieve them encourages managers and employees to think of new and better ways of doing things. It provides an opportunity for innovative ideas to emerge, as people think outside the box to find the best course of action.

4. Facilitates decision making: Planning pre-defines the goals and the range of acceptable actions, making it easier for managers to choose among available alternatives. When a plan is in place, decision making becomes faster and more rational because decisions are guided by established objectives and policies. This reduces time wasted on deliberation and prevents hasty, unconsidered choices.

questions.solution: This is an either/or question. Refer to sub-questions (a) and (b) for complete model answers.

आशीष अपने घर के लिए एक एलसीडी टेलीविज़न खरीदना चाहता था। उसने निर्णय लिया कि वह इलेक्ट्रॉनिक वस्तुओं की बिक्री करने वाले विभिन्न स्टोर्स पर जाएगा और विभिन्न ब्राण्ड्स की उपलब्ध प्रकारों की जाँच करेगा। उसका एक मित्र उसे एक निर्माता के पास लेकर गया जो एलसीडी टेलीविज़न लगभग आधे मूल्य पर बेच रहा था। निर्माता ने एलसीडी टेलीविज़न की विभिन्न विशेषताओं का वर्णन किया और इस बात पर ज़ोर दिया कि आशीष उससे ही एलसीडी टेलीविज़न खरीदे। आशीष ने टेलीविज़न उसी से खरीदने का निर्णय लिया जबकि टेलीविज़न पर कोई मानक चिह्न भी नहीं था। जब आशीष ने कैश मीमो के बारे में पूछा तो निर्माता ने उसे यह कहकर हतोत्साहित कर दिया कि इससे उसे अतिरिक्त कर देना होगा। उसने आशीष से यह भी कहा कि चिन्ता करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है और यदि टेलीविज़न में कोई समस्या होगी तो वह उसे तुरन्त बदल देगा। एक ही माह में टेलीविज़न में खराबी आ गई और आशीष ने उसे बदलने की बात कही। निर्माता ने एलसीडी टेलीविज़न बदलने के लिए यह कहकर मना कर दिया कि यह समस्या टेलीविज़न का लापरवाही से उपयोग करने के कारण है। आशीष ने निर्माता के विरुद्ध उपभोक्ता अदालत में शिकायत दर्ज़ कराने का निर्णय लिया।
(i) उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित दो उपभोक्ता अधिकारों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
(ii) दो उपभोक्ता उत्तरदायित्वों का उल्लेख कीजिए जिनका एलसीडी टेलीविज़न खरीदते समय आशीष ने पालन नहीं किया।
questions.text_english:
Ashish wanted to purchase one LCD TV for his home. He decided to go to various stores selling electronic items to check the available varieties of different brands. One of his friends took him to a manufacturer selling LCD TV at almost half the price. The manufacturer described its various features and insisted that Ashish buys the LCD TV from him. Seeing the features, Ashish decided to buy the TV from him, even when the TV was not having any standardisation mark on it. When Ashish asked for the cash memo, the manufacturer discouraged him, saying that it will attract additional tax. He further told Ashish not to worry and promised that if there would be any problem with the TV, he would replace it immediately. The TV started malfunctioning within a month and Ashish asked for its replacement. The manufacturer refused to replace the LCD TV, telling him that the problem is due to mishandling of the TV. Ashish decided to file a complaint in the Consumer Court against the manufacturer.
(i) Identify and explain two consumer rights discussed in the above case.
(ii) State two consumer responsibilities that Ashish did not fulfil while buying the LCD TV.

sub_questions.text: उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित दो उपभोक्ता अधिकारों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify and explain two consumer rights discussed in the above case.

key_points: Right to be informed — Ashish asked for a cash memo and information about the product; the manufacturer withheld information
Right to seek redressal — Ashish filed a complaint in the Consumer Court when the TV malfunctioned and the manufacturer refused to replace it

sub_questions.solution:
Two consumer rights discussed in the above case are:

1. Right to be Informed: This right gives the consumer the right to receive complete and accurate information about the quality, quantity, purity, standard, and price of goods or services. In the case, when Ashish asked for a cash memo, the manufacturer discouraged him by falsely claiming it would attract additional tax. The manufacturer withheld this information to avoid giving a proper receipt. Ashish had every right to receive a cash memo as proof of purchase and accurate information about the price and taxes involved.

2. Right to Seek Redressal: This right gives every consumer the right to seek remedy or compensation against unfair trade practices or unscrupulous exploitation. In the case, when the TV malfunctioned within a month and the manufacturer refused to replace it by blaming Ashish for mishandling, Ashish exercised his right to seek redressal by filing a complaint in the Consumer Court against the manufacturer. This right ensures that consumers are not helpless when they receive defective goods or are deceived by sellers.

sub_questions.text: दो उपभोक्ता उत्तरदायित्वों का उल्लेख कीजिए जिनका एलसीडी टेलीविज़न खरीदते समय आशीष ने पालन नहीं किया।
sub_questions.text_english: State two consumer responsibilities that Ashish did not fulfil while buying the LCD TV.

key_points: Did not insist on a cash memo/receipt — allowed the manufacturer to discourage him from taking a proof of purchase
Bought a product without a standardisation (ISI/BIS) mark — did not check quality certification

sub_questions.solution:
Two consumer responsibilities that Ashish failed to fulfil while buying the LCD TV are:

1. Responsibility to insist on a cash memo/receipt: It is a consumer's responsibility to always insist on a proper bill, cash memo, or receipt at the time of purchase. Ashish did not insist on a cash memo when the manufacturer discouraged him by saying it would attract extra tax. A cash memo is essential proof of purchase, especially for making warranty or guarantee claims later.

2. Responsibility to check for quality/standardisation marks: It is a consumer's responsibility to look for quality certification marks (such as ISI, BIS, Agmark, Hallmark) before buying a product. These marks certify that the product has been tested and meets prescribed quality standards. The case clearly states that 'the TV was not having any standardisation mark on it', yet Ashish bought it. By ignoring this responsibility, Ashish exposed himself to the risk of purchasing a substandard product.

key_points: Consumer rights: Right to be informed and Right to seek redressal
Consumer responsibilities: Insisting on cash memo and checking for standardisation marks
